name: Karina James
quote: The support I've received has been essential to me. Our donors' generosity has provided me with on-campus resources that support my daily growth and success. I am incredibly thankful for the opportunities that I will have in the future.

name: Grace Freiberger
quote: Our donors have truly become family to us, sharing in our journey and providing the 'home' we need to represent our community with pride. Their belief in us creates a ripple effect of motivation, driving us to perform our best on and off the court.

name: Troy Sudbrook
quote: When I chose to pursue my dream of playing collegiate baseball at Toledo, I never knew it would come with so much more and provide a roadmap for my future. The University of Toledo will always be a part of me when I begin my career in business.
